one_line: A card-drafting and polyomino game where each player fits rescued cat tiles onto a boat, keeping cat families together while scoring personal lesson cards over five rounds.
Victorian-era estate-building game where you build a deck of guests, renovate your manor with tiles and manage servants with a worker-placement system.
Tile-drafting game where you pick colored azulejo tiles from factory displays and place them on a wall to score for rows, columns and sets.
Medieval Euro where each player builds a bag of followers, draws from it every round and uses them to trade, build and research across France.
Co-op deduction game: one player is a ghost who sends vision cards, and the psychics interpret them to name the suspect, location and object.
A fantasy character-building dice game where players draft dice, fill in stat rows on a character sheet and buy gear and skills from a card market.
A stand-alone Clank! deck-builder where players lay dungeon tiles to build the catacombs, steal artifacts and escape the dragon.
A cooperative superhero game where players play Marvel heroes from decks of cards to build a storyline, rescuing civilians and clearing threats to defeat a villain controlled by the game.
A cooperative miniatures game where one to five investigators start the game insane in the 1920s, summon an Elder One on purpose, and then try to destroy it across short Episodes.
Space opera for 2-4 players where trick-taking-style card play picks actions and ambitions, with quick risk-based battles.
Space-search euro for 1-4 players: launch probes, scan the sky and analyze data over five rounds to find alien life.
